description: This file defines a Java interface named CodeValueReadPlatformService, which provides methods for retrieving code value data based on different criteria within the Fineract platform. It includes method signatures for fetching code values by code string, fetching all code values associated with a code ID, and retrieving a specific code value by its ID. The file also contains licensing information, package declaration, and imports necessary for the interface.

classes.name: CodeValueReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for reading code value information from the platform.

methods.name: retrieveCodeValuesByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a list of code value data objects associated with the specified code string.

methods.name: retrieveAllCodeValues
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of all code value data objects associated with the specified code ID.

methods.name: retrieveCodeValue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific code value data object by its unique identifier.
